name: Climate.Template → Publish
description: Report the device's actual state from elsewhere in your YAML file (e.g. after parsing a UART response) with the `climate.template.publish` action. Unlike a command coming from the frontend, this is a pure state report: it sets the fields you specify and publishes once, but it never triggers `on_control` or any set action.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the template climate device.

config_entries.label: Action
config_entries.description: The climate action to publish. Only takes effect if `supports_action: true` is set. One of `OFF`, `COOLING`, `HEATING`, `IDLE`, `DRYING`, `FAN`, `DEFROSTING`. If using a lambda, use e.g. `climate::CLIMATE_ACTION_HEATING`.

config_entries.label: Current Humidity
config_entries.description: The measured humidity to publish. Same caveat as `current_temperature`, but for `humidity_sensor` / `supports_current_humidity`.

config_entries.label: Current Temperature
config_entries.description: The measured temperature to publish. Usually not needed -- prefer wiring up `sensor` instead, so the value stays live automatically. Only visible over the API if `sensor` or `supports_current_temperature: true` is also configured (i.e. the current-temperature feature is advertised).

config_entries.label: Custom Fan Mode
config_entries.description: The custom fan mode to publish (must be one of the strings in `custom_fan_modes`). Exclusive with `fan_mode`.

config_entries.label: Custom Preset
config_entries.description: The custom preset to publish (must be one of the strings in `custom_presets`). Exclusive with `preset`.

config_entries.label: Fan Mode
config_entries.description: The fan mode to publish. Exclusive with `custom_fan_mode`.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: The operating mode to publish. One of `OFF`, `HEAT`, `COOL`, `AUTO`, `HEAT_COOL`, `FAN_ONLY`, `DRY`. If using a lambda, use e.g. `climate::CLIMATE_MODE_HEAT`.

config_entries.label: Preset
config_entries.description: The preset to publish. Exclusive with `custom_preset`.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature
config_entries.description: The target temperature to publish. Cannot be used together with `target_temperature_low` / `target_temperature_high`.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature High
config_entries.description: The upper bound of a two-point target temperature range to publish. Must be used together with `target_temperature_low`.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Low
config_entries.description: The lower bound of a two-point target temperature range to publish. Must be used together with `target_temperature_high`.
